A.name: sami-peek-door
A.p: 3D animated movie scene. A cheerful young man with short curly black hair, a short neat black beard and an olive-green hoodie is hiding behind the edge of an old stone wall, peeking out with half of his face. He smoothly steps out from behind the wall into full view, grins widely at the camera and waves hello with his hand. Jasmine flowers sway gently in the breeze. Static camera. Pixar-like 3D animation style, soft cinematic lighting, smooth natural motion, his face stays the same.

B.name: sami-coffee-reveal
B.p: 3D animated movie scene. A young man with short curly black hair and a short neat black beard in an olive-green hoodie sits in a cozy cafe holding a big coffee cup in front of his mouth. He slowly lowers the cup, revealing a surprised happy face with a big smile, then raises his eyebrows playfully and smiles at the camera. Warm lamps glow in the background. Static camera. Pixar-like 3D animation style, soft cinematic lighting, smooth natural motion, his face stays the same.

C.name: lina-notebook-lookup
C.p: 3D animated movie scene. A young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow cardigan over a white shirt, sits at a cafe table writing in her notebook. She stops writing, looks up from the notebook toward the camera, smiles warmly and gives a small friendly wave with her hand. Static camera. Pixar-like 3D animation style, soft cinematic lighting, smooth natural motion, her face stays the same.
